scope: Versioned readiness record for a deterministic source-local materializer that consumes the checked-in Q011 resource-scaling plan, the human-selected ps_p0_1p00 receipt, and the Section 5.4 production deck. It emits engineering-only pilot decks and non-authorizing registered-control-plane config fragments. It does not mutate historical preregistrations, shared control-plane files, live policy, or scheduler state.

registered_control_plane_compatibility.planner_retention_boundary: A separately reviewed pilot planner-retention binding accepted by the installed control plane is required before any registered execution. This materializer does not fabricate a qualifying-campaign planner binding or modify shared controller code.

execution_gates: All source bindings must still match exact bytes.
A final clean candidate, executable, environment profile, directive-only normal-QOS job template, analysis-script set, walltime, and timeout-margin artifact must be separately bound.
Each case requires a separately reviewed registered-science policy slice and fresh pre_manifest and pre_submit_wrapper operator attestations.
Each case requires a valid Q011 planner-retention binding accepted by the installed control plane.
Phase 1 selected-node repeats may run only for the selected node count and at most three times.
Phase 2 and Phase 3 remain blocked until their preceding Q011-RS gates pass and node counts are separately reviewed.
Registered pilot execution must remain serial and stop before 500 consumed node-hours.
Engineering-pilot physical fields, spectra, shock morphology, magnetic amplification, scientific profiles, residuals, and qualifying outputs may not be inspected.
